name: Gabumon
description: Although it is covered by a fur pelt, it is clearly a Reptile Digimon. Due to its extremely timid and shy personality, it always gathers up the data that Garurumon leaves behind and shapes it into a fur pelt to wear. That fur pelt of Garurumon, who is feared by other Digimon, thus plays a role in safeguarding and protecting Gabumon. When it is wearing the fur pelt, its personality does a complete 180° shift.
